items.note: Editorial note on the Skanda Purana Khandesvara legend: a maidservant and her husband of the Vaishya community of Vidisa are reborn as Queen Kantimati and King Bhadrashva. Names Vidisa in a puranic tale; not historical evidence.

In the same Skanda Purana legend the queen was formerly a maidservant of the Vaisya Haridatta in the city of Vaidisa, who worshipped Mahakala; a legendary reference to the city, not historical evidence.
